text:
Three stages in making steel from iron ore are listed.
X
carbon dioxide reacts with carbon
Y
basic oxides and oxygen are added
Z
hematite is reduced
In which order do these stages occur?
A
X → Y → Z
B
X → Z → Y
C
Y → X → Z
D
Z → Y → X
subject: Chemistry
